statement.zh: Kaiser 等在 MDAIK 26（1970）发表象岛「城镇与神庙」项目首份正式发掘季报，开启 DAI 长期田野系列。
statement.en: Kaiser et al. published the inaugural formal season report of the Elephantine town-and-temple project in MDAIK 26 (1970), beginning the DAI long-term field series.

editorial.notes: Density pass D-2026-10-11-22; fact claims cite registered sources only.
